🧭 Local travel essentials
Getting around
LRT (light rail) + city buses + free hotel/casino shuttles are your main transit options. Macau Pass is the transit card. Macau Arena (Macau East Asian Games Dome area) is accessible by shuttle and taxi.
See more
Late-night transit
Last buses and LRT vary by line—roughly midnight. Some casino shuttles run late. Taxis thin out after hours. Confirm your hotel's shuttle before the show.
Payment
Cash and card both work. Casinos and resorts welcome cards; small shops prefer cash. QR codes (AlipayHK, WeChat Pay) are spreading.
Currency & exchange
Macau Pataca (MOP). Hong Kong Dollar (HKD) widely accepted—you may get change in MOP. Currency exchange and ATMs everywhere.
Language
Cantonese and Portuguese (official). English is widely understood in tourist and casino areas.
Local apps
Google Maps (Bus & Walking Routes) · Official Macau Bus / DSAT (Bus Real-Time Arrival (Local Official)) · AlipayHK (QR quick pay)
Late-night transit
Macau Taxi (taxi calling app) (Local Taxis) · Hotel / Casino shuttles (Free Resort Shuttles—Some Run Late (Spreads the Load))  📶 eSIM ↗
How to book
After Macau Arena exits, taxis fall short of demand. Use hotel and casino shuttle stops nearby to spread the load—skip the main entrance.
Last-train info
LRT & buses close around midnight; some casino shuttles run late. Confirm hotel-shuttle availability & taxi availability in advance.
